evidence.note: MTLD3D12Device::CheckFeatureSupport is the current runtime implementation.
Phase 4 will prove these reports without launching a game.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS.risk: Over-reporting can push games into unimplemented render paths.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS1.risk: WaveOps reporting must remain coupled to the 32-lane dispatch/readback corpus.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS3_WRITE_BUFFE.risk: Copy-queue timestamps are coalesced to the Metal command buffer GPU end time and resolved through a completion handler; write-immediate flags are coupled to exact default, marker-in, and marker-out GPU virtual-address readback coverage on direct, compute, and inlined bundle command lists.

D3D12_METAL_RAYTRACING_HARDWARE.risk: Metal hardware support is only a prerequisite; DXR tier must remain unreported until acceleration structures, state objects, shader tables, synchronization, and DispatchRays pass behavior gates.

BLAS COPY_MODE_CLONE and cloned-BLAS TLAS traversal

in-place TLAS PERFORM_UPDATE refit from translated to centered instance

COPY_MODE_SERIALIZE, opaque buffer copy, COPY_MODE_DESERIALIZE, and traversal through deserialized BLAS and TLAS

raygen, miss, triangle any-hit/closest-hit, procedural intersection/closest-hit, and callable shader-table records

D3D12_DXR_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURES.risk: A twelve-geometry indexed/non-indexed triangle BLAS, one-AABB BLAS, behavior-proven BLAS clone, shifted triangle/AABB/TLAS refits, compacted-size query, traversed compact copy, process-scoped BLAS/TLAS serialization and deserialization through a copied opaque blob, a twelve-instance TLAS with exact serialized pointer list, source-resource release before deserialized-TLAS traversal, mask-isolated inline RayQuery hit, stable distinct export identifiers with the Metal Shader Converter local-sampler slot preserved at bytes 16-23 and private alias hashes isolated to bytes 24-31, filtered same-table multi-collection merging with renamed imports and invalid-export rejection, executed base/grown hit-group records with associated local-root constant/CBV/SRV/UAV data, renamed and indexed miss/callable table records, raygen/triangle-any-hit/closest-hit/procedural-intersection records, and depth-2 recursive TraceRay prove foundational DXR execution; mixed triangle/AABB geometry within one BLAS, persistent cross-process serialized reconstruction, independently linked collection merging, new-library state-object growth, local descriptor tables/samplers, and broader record-count/stride/local-data shader-table matrices remain gated.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS7.risk: Sampler feedback uses padded software maps with SIMD-cooperative locking. Committed and placed resources, invalid-descriptor rejection, feedback UAV pairing, clear, min-mip and mip-region-used writes, 2D arrays, encode/decode resolves, contention, and all four HLSL write forms pass exact compute/pixel readback; tier 0.9 is reported because wrap and clamp are conservatively covered while unrestricted tier-1.0 SRV/addressing behavior remains gated. Mesh AS/MS execution is substantial but mixed render-state breadth and PIPELINE_STATISTICS1 remain insufficient for mesh tier 1.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS11.risk: ResourceDescriptorHeap atomic64 uses the same software lock lowering as raw and typed resources. A directly-indexed heap add stress and add/and/or/xor/min/max/exchange/compare-exchange matrix pass exact readback; direct heap descriptors are rebound after ordinary root tables so heap indices retain D3D12 meaning.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS12.risk: Enhanced barriers close active Metal encoders and establish queue order through the command-queue shared event. The report is backed by global, buffer, and texture groups plus exact copy-destination to copy-source buffer readback. Relaxed casting is limited to explicitly declared Device10 castable formats and is backed by committed/placed R32_FLOAT-to-R32_UINT readback, cross-layout R8G8B8A8_UINT readback, mismatched-unit-size creation rejection, and rejection of an undeclared R32_SINT view.

proven_subset: compute-stage uint32 GatherRaw through a declared castable format
depth SRV comparison sampling and DSV mip clear selection
D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS14.risk: Compute-stage exact readbacks prove the three advanced texture operation families, but the global Options14 bit remains false until graphics-stage coverage passes. Writable MSAA texture creation, binding, per-sample stores, and readback are still unimplemented and unreported.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS8.risk: The support report is backed by creation and upload/readback of a 7x5 BC1 texture with exact two-row block payload validation.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS9.risk: Native Metal atomic_ulong remains insufficient. DXMT serializes 64-bit atomic critical sections through 32-bit Metal locks, uses SIMD-cooperative lane selection to avoid same-SIMD spinlock deadlock, and proves 64-thread add stress plus unsigned/signed operation and compare-exchange matrices for typed resources and group-shared memory.

D3D12_FEATURE_LEVEL_12_2_TARGET.risk: Raising the central maximum before every FL12_2 behavior gate passes would recreate false-success device creation.

D3D12_FEATURE_FEATURE_LEVELS.risk: UE5 may reject the adapter if this disagrees with shader model or options queries.

D3D12_FEATURE_SHADER_MODEL.risk: SM 6.7 is behavior-backed by the SM 6.6 root-constant, descriptor-indexing, 64-bit, atomic/barrier, and texture/sampler runtime corpus plus SM 6.7 QuadAny/QuadAll dispatch/readback. Compute-stage programmable offsets, GatherRaw, and SampleCmpLevel now pass as a separate Options14 subset, while graphics-stage breadth and writable MSAA remain gated.

D3D12_SYNTHETIC_SHADER_CORPUS.risk: Game captures must remain diagnostic; shader support claims require synthetic corpus coverage.

purpose: Keep D3D12 feature reports aligned with executable implementation reality.
